title: Microgravity Processing
description: On the ground a melt with a warm side and a cool side stirs itself: the warm liquid is lighter and rises. Whether it does is told by one number, Rayleigh's, the push of buoyancy against the drag of viscosity and the smoothing of heat; past about 1,708 the melt rolls. In orbit gravity is a hundred thousand times smaller and the melt stays still, so crystals grow without striations and glasses cool without crystallising. A free surface still stirs itself, pulled by surface tension (the Marangoni effect), unless it is capped. Unlocks the Microgravity Factory, which works only aboard the Orbital Station.

puzzle.goal: A layer of fluid of depth L is warmer by ΔT at the bottom, under gravity g. It has thermal expansion β, kinematic viscosity ν and thermal diffusivity α. Write the Rayleigh number Ra, the ratio of buoyancy to the damping.
puzzle.name: Rayleigh number
puzzle.form: g * β * ΔT * L ^ 3 / ( ν * α )
puzzle.expr: g * b * dT * L ^ 3 / ( nu * a )
puzzle.ask: Find Ra for water (β = 2e-4 /K, ν = 1e-6 m²/s, α = 1.4e-7 m²/s), ΔT = @{dT} K, L = 0.02 m, at g = 9.81 m/s².
puzzle.method: Buoyancy gβΔT against the two damping rates ν/L² and α/L², over the depth: the L³ comes from both.
